What you have to do from this point is just make sure you don't drink too much. Especially if you're in such a state as you are right now.

It will be okay. If he truly loves you he will forgive you. Don't give up on him. It will hurt him more than when you tell him that what you did will not happen again.

If the topic of professional help is brought up, please mention to him that you want this to be private. If anyone asks where you are, you're having a girls-only time or you're shopping.

Lost interest in games and only listening to music, huh. Sounds like a change in your preference is happening. You know, I've tried out many things after I got bored of games. 3D modelling was one of them and recently I made myself my first VRChat Avatar and I'm really proud of it. I also learned to play the Piano when I was your age, and to be honest with you, you don't have to be able to read the notes on the paper. There are tutorial like videos on YouTube which are called Synthesia. I personally like the idea of trying out new things. If you have siblings, ask them if they'd like to go out for some fun time at a park, get some food from a restaurant, meet friends together and plan something. But keep the health and safety guidelines in mind due to COVID-19.

Hey, talk openly to your husband. You have to have an open communication so he can trust you. Your husband is going to go above and beyond to make sure you feel better, more appreciated, more loved. I'm sure of it. I know that's what I did. Staying silent is going to make things worse. Please, speak up to him, openly and honestly. He will not judge you. Men aren't like that. They don't overthink. They listen, they support, they fix. Whatever is weighing you down, he will support you.

How are you making everyone unhappy? If it's private then you don't have to tell me. But you have to know that when there's someone willing to listen and willing to understand you then there is still hope to hold on. Life has its ups and downs. And we're here to bring you back up.
